Mercedes Metris Custom Decals

If you are looking to increase the exposure of your brand or simply want to make your business/corporate vehicle more colorful, this article is for you. This article is on our client City of Toronto – Toronto Community Crisis Service and how they branded their car.

Vehicle Branding for the City of Toronto

Toronto Community Crisis Service (TCCS) wanted to have the company logo on their commercial van, a Mercedes Metris. Their community safety initiatives are widely known in order for them to offer services that are based on Indigenous conceptions of holistic health and well-being, therefore brand exposure is crucial to them. After speaking with our graphic design specialists and sales team, they opted to install the logos for the City of Toronto, Toronto Community Crisis Service (TCCS), and Kamaamwizme wii Naagidiwendiiying, which refers to joining together to heal/look after/take care of each other.

Wrapping Process

The vinyl materials from Avery Dennison and the decal colors of green and black were deemed to be the best suitable for this project by our specialists. The van was then in the care of our installers, who have more than 10 years of expertise in the automobile wrapping business. Since the vehicle was back in operation after 48 hours and ready to advertise with its inventive decals, our speedy turnaround significantly reduced the amount of time Toronto Community Crisis Service (TCCS)’s were unavailable.

We advise speaking with our staff whether you’d like to find out more about decals, lettering, and complete wraps or simply want to update the look of your car. You can reach us at 416-746-1381 or email us at info@vinylwraptoronto.com.
